title: Cosmic Serpent Embrace
description: A surreal painting featuring a glossy black humanoid figure with golden eyes and a white horned alien-like being with black eyes, both entwined by a large green scaled serpent with peacock feather patterns. A small green frog with a glowing yellow orb sits on the white figure's chest while a tiny robed wizard stands on its shoulder. Ethereal female faces and golden flowers float in a cosmic background split between blue and purple starry space.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a sleek black humanoid with golden crackle eyes and a tall white horned alien figure with black eyes standing face to face, their bodies wrapped by a massive emerald green serpent with peacock feather markings and translucent veil. A vibrant green frog holding a glowing orb rests on the white figure's chest. A tiny wizard in blue robe stands on the white figure's shoulder. Floating female faces and golden flowers appear in a swirling cosmic background divided between blue and deep purple starry space.
